test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 3 years 6 months at simple interest, then what will be the annual rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 3 years 6 months at simple interest

Formula used:

Simple Interest (SI) = [Principal (P) × Rate of interest (R) × Time(T)] /100

Concept used:

Amount = Principal + Interest

**Calculation:**

3 years 6 months = 7/2 yr

Let the sum be P,

Now it is 2P

Interest will be

2P - P = P

As per the question,

P = [ (P) × (R) × 7] /(100 × 2)

R = 200/7

⇒ 28.57 %
